prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, new_screen] adoption_care_pledge_new_screen: Insert a new pet care pledge screen before adoption certificate where users confirm their commitment to their new pet.
   config: {"new_care_pledge": {"headline": "Take the Pet Care Pledge", "body": "Promise to interact with and care for your desktop companion.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Official Pledge", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "button", "label": "I Promise", "action": "next"}]}}
1: [choose_path, new_flow] choose_path_interactive_quiz_flow: Replace static selection on choose_path with a split-screen interactive personality preview flow.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "text": "Select your companion vibe", "style": "playful"}]}}
2: [adoption, redesign] pick_friend_spotlight_redesign: Redesign pick_friend screen using a focused spotlight layout highlighting pet animations.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Companion"}}
3: [home, new_screen] waiting_desktop_readiness_new_screen: Add a new screen before waiting that verifies desktop overlay readiness and window permissions.
   config: {"new_desktop_readiness": {"headline": "Verifying Desktop Readiness", "body": "Checking screen overlay permissions so your pet displays seamlessly.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Screen Overlay Permission", "style": "plain"}]}}
4: [choose_path, hint] story_completion_time_hint: Add an onboarding duration hint on the story screen promising setup in under 2 minutes.
   config: {"story": {"hint": "Onboarding takes less than 2 minutes!"}}
5: [sign_in, notification] sign_in_device_sync_notification: Add an account sync notification banner on sign_in explaining account safety across reinstalls.
   config: {"sign_in": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Sign in to keep your pet data safe across reinstalls and device switches."}}
6: [adoption, incentive] adoption_certificate_mascot_incentive: Display a celebratory mascot badge on the adoption certificate screen to mark completion.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "mascot", "text": "Welcome to the family!", "style": "playful"}]}}
7: [home, wait_info] waiting_tip_carousel_wait_info: Add a tip carousel on the waiting screen explaining how to interact with the pet.
   config: {"waiting": {"tip_delay_seconds": 5, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Tip: Right-click your pet to access settings anytime!", "style": "calm"}]}}
8: [finish, copy] home_intro_desktop_controls_copy: Update copy on home_intro screen to clearly detail desktop movement and pet visibility shortcuts.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "body": "Click and drag to position your pet. Right-click to access controls, mute sound, or hide."}}
9: [sign_in, redesign] sign_in_choice_cards_redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen with a centered layout and bold choice cards for single-click auth.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "text": "Choose your sign-in method", "style": "rounded"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Adding a new pet care pledge screen inside onboarding is allowed under Rule 4.
Choosing a companion vibe removes the required choice between adopting and making your own.
Redesigning the pick_friend layout with a spotlight view preserves its core function.
Adding a desktop readiness verification screen inside onboarding is allowed under Rule 4.
Adding a simple duration hint to the story screen is allowed.
Adding an account sync informational banner on the sign-in screen is allowed.
Replacing the certificate components with a mascot badge loses the required official stamp.
Adding a tip carousel to the waiting screen is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.
Updating copy on the home_intro overlay is allowed as part of onboarding.
Redesigning the sign-in screen layout while retaining sign-in functionality is allowed.
